findings.detail: X-Signature response header is returned by the handler but is not declared in the 202 response's headers in the spec
findings.evidence: handlers/misc.go:60 (w.Header().Set("X-Signature", "sha256=deadbeef")) vs spec paths./webhooks/test.post.responses.202, which declares no headers

findings.detail: accountNumber, bankCode, amount and currency are declared required in PayoutRequest, but the handler only rejects a miss
findings.evidence: spec components.PayoutRequest.required = [accountNumber, bankCode, amount, currency, reference]; handlers/payouts.go:26-34 validates only req.Reference

findings.detail: payoutId and amount are declared required in RefundRequest, but the handler performs no field validation and returns 201
findings.evidence: spec components.RefundRequest.required = [payoutId, amount]; handlers/payouts.go:85-97 decodes the body and immediately writes the 201 response

findings.detail: 409 (Duplicate reference) is documented in the spec but CreatePayout has no code path that returns 409
findings.evidence: spec paths./payouts.post.responses.409; handlers/payouts.go:21-44 only ever returns 201 or 400 (no http.StatusConflict)

findings.detail: 422 (Refund not permitted) is documented in the spec but CreateRefund has no code path that returns 422
findings.evidence: spec paths./refunds.post.responses.422; handlers/payouts.go:85-97 only ever returns 201 or 400 (no http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
